rationale_bullets: Colandrea arrives as the reigning MW Player of the Year with full-volume tape: 89.9 PFF/514 dropbacks at UNLV (MWC -7 -> 82.9 adjusted, ~p77), 3,459 @ 65.9% with a 23-5 ratio (PS) plus 649 rush yds and 10 rush TDs (P6).

The named risk is variance: 'gunslinger... will also turn it over (29 picks and 17 fumbles over three seasons)' (P6); his Virginia stint (11 starts, 26-20 ratio) is the mediocre-P4 prior - though the 2025 ratio shows the correction.
The fit is specifically engineered: Holgorsen studied Pavia off-script film; the scramble element addresses the exact sack profile PFF pinned on Raiola (PBLK 88p vs #112 sack-rate outcome).
Depth is genuinely three-deep: Lateef (52.0/155; won his UCLA start) + Kaelin (Virginia returnee).
62, M = the Houser tier: similar adjusted tape with a POY laurel, same earlier-P4-struggle shape, wider turnover tails.
data_gaps: Spring reporting on the Holgorsen install beyond books
Turnover profile vs B10 defenses untested

rationale_bullets: Emmett Johnson is gone to the draft (85.6 PFF/251 att; 1,451 @ 5.8 + 370 receiving; 2nd-team All-American; rd-5 KC) - a yr3 early declare caught by the override mechanism (feed would print RETURNS).

Rhule chose NOT to supplement from the portal (P6) - the room is hints only: Nelson (82.3/28), converted WR Mozee (73.1/26), hamstring-limited power back Ives (75.9/20), and true FR Rule (PS#46; 75-yd spring TD; 'home run ability').
PS is direct: 'Rhule likes his top 4 RBs, but they won't match Johnson's production.'
~74 combined 2025 attempts across the entire projected room - priors, not evidence; behind a line whose run-blocking graded 88p.
40, M = the same priors-only shape as Michigan State's bought room minus the buying.

Two experienced starters return with near-identical tape: Hunter (69.0/334 -> 68.0; team-high 617 @ 14.3; 'could push for All-Big Ten' - P6) and Barney (68.8/316 -> 67.8; a 55-catch true-FR year in 2024).
TE Lindenmeyer (66.9/279 -> 65.9; 29/312) earned HM All-B10 and returns as a real outlet.
The add replaces the loss almost exactly: Gilmer (61.0/430 at UCLA -> 60.0; 12 starts) in for Key (65.9/338, yr4); P6: 'the starting trio are experienced former four-stars.'
Clark (68.5/86) is Athlon's breakout name; the room's ceiling rests on Hunter's leap and the new QB's downfield aggression.
Weighted aggregate ~64.9 (~p42) + experience/continuity = 52, M - fittingly, a whisker above the Nebraska-WRTE-2025 exemplar that defines 50.

The analytic split governs this grade: PFF graded the 2025 line 88th percentile in BOTH pass- and run-blocking while the sack-rate OUTCOME was #112 - 21 of 33 sacks came in three games and PFF charged them to the QB's time-to-throw. The QB who held the ball left; a scrambler arrived.
The best returning interior tape in this B10 round: C Evans (78.6/798 -> 77.6) plus ex-5* LT Pritchett (68.5/552 -> 67.5; 'developing into a pro prospect' - P6) and OFY-returnee Gottula (70.0/338).

Four linemen (117 career starts) left, but the imports bring 123 starts and land ABOVE the departures after offsets: Black (66.9/738 at ISU, B12 +8 -> 74.9; 30 starts, 4* transfer grade), Babalade (60.1/421 at SC, SEC +13 -> 73.1), Mubenga (51.6/298 at LSU -> 64.6) - all recruited by new line coach Wade (Georgia Tech pedigree).
PS (attributed): 'they can only stay healthier... significantly more talented'; two OFY tackles return to depth.
Weighted aggregate ~73.2 (~p77), graded to 66, M for five-man gel risk and the outcome history.
data_gaps: Whether the sack split repeats with a mobile QB

rationale_bullets: The 2025 production was near the FBS floor: PRSH 4th percentile, 22 sacks (<2/game), 175 rush ypg allowed (4.8), #114 vs the run (P6). PS: 'from a strength to a question mark.'
The departures were low-graded but voluminous: Jeudy (54.1/464) + Davis (64.1/406) both to Miami (P6), McCullough (66.0/350).

The case for improvement is scheme + pedigree: the 4-man front showcases ex-5* Nwaneri (63.4/463 -> 73.4; 'should emerge' - PS), with Whittington (70.6/250 at Pitt -> 71.6; 'breakout freshman') and Stoudmire (69.7/80, BC) added inside, A.Jones (59.1/490, UCLA) on the edge.
Athlon frames the stakes: line improvement 'is paramount' and the adds are 'expected to add instant pass rush.'
Mechanical aggregate ~69.8 (~p55) flatters 54-63 raw tape via the B10 +10; the production floor holds the grade at 46, M.
data_gaps: Whether Nwaneri's leap is scheme-driven or hope

rationale_bullets: The DC brought his own anchor: Chambliss (85.5 PFF/765 at SDSU, MWC -5 -> 80.5) - 110 tackles and 1st-team All-MW playing for Aurich in this exact 4-2-5; the strongest scheme-continuity prior a transfer can carry.
Shavers returns as the proven B10 piece: 70.3/547 (-> 86.3), 61 tkl/7.5 TFL through injuries, a Blackshirt.

GONE: Wright (78.8/560 - the best 2025 tape) and Watson-Trent (68.4/333; the SBC POY import). Foster (62.5/436 at Oregon State) and Hawthorne (ISU) deepen; both adds are the 6'3 frame Aurich wanted (P6).
PS: 'the top unit of the defense... bigger and more experienced.'
Weighted aggregate ~78.3 (~p76); LB caution moderated by real volumes on both anchors. 62, M.
The 2025 room held up: #3 nationally in pass ypg, #28 in P6's opponent-adjusted number, PDR #30, and PS calls the 2026 group 'my #15 rated unit.'
RETURN: Marshall (70.0/662 -> 76.0) - the returning All-B10 corner - plus D.Jones (72.2/658 -> 78.2 as a FRESHMAN; moves to the new nickel), Guthrie (59.1/532; started the last 8), Conn (75.5/114).
The import is scheme-continuous: McDougle (79.3/716 at SDSU, MWC -2 -> 77.3) was Aurich's own starting safety.

GONE: both All-B10 DBs - C.Wright (66.6/670) and Singleton (72.2/644) - plus Hartzog (Arizona). CB2 is a 5* true FR (Odem, the two-deep's only blue-chipper) vs Charles; P6 flags the scheme-change youth.
Weighted aggregate ~73.4 (~p77); CB2 projection + scheme install land it at 65, M.
data_gaps: Guthrie's low grade at volume (59.1/532) vs his 8 starts

rationale_bullets: ST rule: start at the 97th-percentile prior SPEC (PS STR #18 - highest since 2014) and adjust: BOTH legs return - K Cunanan (16-19, long of 52) and ambipedal Aussie P Wilson (39.4/38.3 net).
Subtractions: KR K.Williams (95-yd TD; 32.9 avg) to MSU, and STC Ekeler to USC - Maher (ex-NFL/Nebraska K) takes over; LS Wills imported from MSU.
Barney takes the return jobs (Athlon) - a proven space player, unproven returner.
62, M - the Utah-62 shape: strong prior, legs retained, coordinator/returner churn. PS: 'could drop some after the large rise.'
